Notes:
- Meal breaks are scheduled on every shift longer than 5 hours (the 30-minute unpaid break is not counted as hours worked), so 8.5-hour shifts count as 8 hours and 6-hour shifts as 5.5 hours. No one exceeds their max hours or 40 hours, so there is no overtime.
- Every shift is at least 11 hours from the previous day's end to the next start, so no rest-break premium applies.
- No employees aged 14–15 are on the roster, so the youth limits do not apply. Sam (16) has no hour limits under federal law.
- Two rules weren't checked in the rest-break logic because no shift can start within 10 hours of the prior day's end under these hours. Please confirm the meal-break assumption matches your timekeeping setup.
